- [LLOG.11.1] **Logical lifetime is a schema-level property**, declared on
  the schema header (`schema X scope logical:`). Not a per-rule opt-in.
  `emit X logical` requires `X` to be declared `logical`, and an `emit X` of a
  schema declared `logical` requires the `logical` keyword; either mismatch
  is `DS_VALIDATE_BAD_LIFECYCLE_FLAG`. Declaring it per schema keeps the
  lifetime visible at the declaration and prevents accidental mixing.
